newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end weaker, hovers near support.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end weaker, hovers near support.

text.p: Philippine shares finished sharply lower on Tuesday as investors turned wary over the direction of the peso and domestic interest rates, traders said.
It was the first time the index closed in negative territory since Friday when the Central Bank announced a de facto devaluation of the peso.

"After the euphoria, investors are more sober, looking at issues that will really benefit from a depreciation and those that will not -- separating the chaff from the grain," said Mayenne Catimbang, research head at Magnum Securities.
